banner.title: Welcome to 3Speak!
banner.text: Videos that belong to the people who make them. New here? Take a quick tour or read the answers to common questions.
banner.textShort: New here? Take a quick tour or read the FAQ.

intro.title: A quick look around
intro.text: This short tour shows you where everything is. It takes about a minute, and you can leave it any time.

about.title: What is 3Speak?
about.text: A free, international video platform with communities for every interest. It belongs to its community, not to a company, and there is no CEO. It is open source and part of the Hive ecosystem, so your account, videos and followers are yours and work in other Hive apps too.

earnCreators.title: Creators earn from day one
earnCreators.text: Every upvote on your video adds to its author rewards, paid out 7 days after you publish. On top of that, 50% of the ad revenue your videos bring in goes to you (you can share part of it with the community you posted in), paid every few days. Unlike most social media platforms, there is no minimum watch time or follower count to reach first.

earnViewers.title: Viewers earn too
earnViewers.text: Just by watching videos, you can earn from the 3Speak reward program: 10% of all ad revenue goes to viewers, shared by what each of them watches. Turn on Viewer rewards in Settings to join. Your comments and upvotes can earn rewards as well.

pagesBar.text: Shorts, Groups, Audio, the leaderboard and more, right here in the top bar.

pagesDesktop.title: All pages in one place
pagesDesktop.text: Click the 3Speak logo to open every page: Shorts, Groups, Audio, the leaderboard and more.

pagesPhone.title: Get around
pagesPhone.text: The bar at the bottom takes you to the feeds, Shorts, Groups and Audio.

search.title: Find anything
search.text: Search for videos, channels and topics.

stories.title: Shorts
stories.text: Short vertical videos. Tap one and swipe through the rest.

feeds.title: Choose your feed
feeds.text: Switch between Discover, the Home Feed, the newest videos and more.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.text: The gear opens Settings: your language, light or dark mode, and which videos you want to see.

faq.title: Questions?
faq.text: The FAQ answers what new people ask most, from creating an account to earning rewards.

account.title: Join in
account.text: With an account you can upload, comment, vote, follow channels and earn rewards. It is free.

done.title: You're all set!
done.text: Enjoy watching. You can restart this tour any time from the FAQ.
